name: Bifrost HTTP v2.4.0
body:
## Bifrost HTTP Transport Release v2.4.0

## ✨ Features

- **Relays** - New relays call non-LLM APIs (Tavily, AWS Textract, Azure Speech, ...) through `/relay/{name}/{path}` with one stored credential, per-route pricing and usage mapping, and streaming. Virtual keys get `relay_grants`, and relay calls are charged to the caller's virtual key, team and customer budgets. Relay Logs record metadata, route-matched headers and (with content logging on) streamed response bodies. Routes can be imported from an OpenAPI document pasted, uploaded or fetched by URL, and header matchers accept any header name. Relays sync from config.json, and a credential is tracked by its `env.` reference, so rotating the value does not re-sync the config
- **Warp Topics** - Warp groups the requests in your logs into topics and broader themes. It files each request under a topic as it is indexed, discovers new topics from unmatched requests, and counts topics over a time window with trends, metrics and scoped reads. Logs can be filtered by topic, and topics link back to their requests. Warp is configurable from config.json, its model calls run over the streaming Responses path, and dead topic rows and deleted logs are pruned
- **MiniMax Provider** - New `minimax` provider for chat completions, Responses, image generation, async video generation, text-to-speech and speech-to-text, with `thinking` passthrough and the `base_resp` error envelope mapped to HTTP status codes
- **BytePlus Provider** - New `byteplus` provider for BytePlus ModelArk: Seed chat completions with `reasoning_effort` mapped onto Ark's `thinking` switch, the native Responses API, embeddings through the multimodal endpoint, Seedream image generation, editing and streaming, and async Seedance video generation (priced by output tokens) with list support
- **AWS SageMaker Provider** - New `sagemaker` provider for real-time endpoints. Chat goes through SageMaker's OpenAI-compatible route (vLLM, SGLang, LMI, llama.cpp containers), and `/sagemaker_passthrough` forwards raw `InvokeEndpoint` and `InvokeEndpointWithResponseStream` calls
- **Azure Speech and Live APIs** - Azure keys reach Azure AI Speech for SSML text-to-speech and fast transcription (`speech/<model>`, enabled with `use_speech_endpoints`), Azure Voice Live realtime sessions (`use_voice_live_endpoints`, with object voices and Voice Live pricing), and GPT Live over `/openai/v1/live/sessions`. A new `/azure` route group lets Azure AI Speech clients and the Azure OpenAI SDK point at Bifrost as their Azure resource, voices appear in list models, `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` is accepted, and Azure Whisper transcriptions are billed by audio duration
- **Bedrock Nova Sonic Realtime** - Amazon Nova Sonic speech-to-speech on the OpenAI Realtime-compatible surface. Clients keep speaking OpenAI Realtime events, and Bifrost translates them onto Bedrock's signed HTTP/2 event stream through a new realtime connector for providers that do not speak WebSocket
- **MCP Prompts and Resources** - Bifrost discovers the prompts, resources and resource templates an upstream MCP server offers and serves them on the MCP gateway (`/mcp`), with `completion/complete` for their arguments. Each server gets `prompts_to_expose` and `resources_to_expose` allow-lists, and virtual keys, Virtual MCPs and include headers narrow them like tools. Prompt and resource reads are logged
- **MCP Protocol 2026-07-28** - mcp-go moves to v1.3.0. A global and per-server max protocol version setting (`auto`, `2026-07-28`, `2025-11-25`, `2025-06-18`) caps what Bifrost offers upstream. Tool results keep images, audio and structured content instead of flattening to text, and tool output schemas, titles, icons and annotations reach clients. Persistent connections re-list tools as soon as an upstream sends `tools/list_changed`, and per-call clients reuse HTTP connections
  <Note>
  The MCP gateway now validates `Origin` as the Streamable HTTP spec requires. Browser requests to `/mcp` from an origin that is not allowed get a `403`. Requests with no `Origin` header (CLIs, SDKs, server-side clients) are unaffected.
  </Note>
- **MCP OAuth CIMD and Issuer Binding** - Upstream MCP OAuth publishes a Client ID Metadata Document at `/api/oauth/client-metadata.json` and registers with it, and the MCP OAuth server accepts CIMD clients. Each MCP client's credentials are bound to the authorization server that issued them, and authorization responses are checked against it (RFC 8414, RFC 9207). The OAuth issuer URL is editable under Settings > Security, and token-exchange settings are validated when a client is created or edited
- **Native Decisions on More Providers** - `/v1/decisions` runs natively on vLLM and SGLang, on Databricks System One (OpenJev), and on Azure gpt-6-luna. OpenAI decisions accept conversation items, JSON parts and prompt caching, and unprefixed models are left to routing instead of being pinned to OpenAI or Typesafe
- **GitHub Copilot Token Auth** - GitHub Copilot keys take a fine-grained PAT or a GitHub OAuth token in `value`, and the UI signs in with GitHub through the device flow. Claude models go to Copilot's native `/v1/messages`, OpenAI models to native `/responses`, and embeddings to `/embeddings`
  <Warning>
  The GitHub App installation mode is removed. `github_copilot_key_config` is no longer accepted, and a GitHub Copilot key without a token in `value` is refused at setup. Replace App-based keys with a PAT or OAuth token before upgrading.
  </Warning>
- **Passthrough Route Allowlist** - Each provider has a passthrough route policy that controls which routes `/openai_passthrough`, `/anthropic_passthrough`, `/azure_passthrough`, `/genai_passthrough` and the other passthrough endpoints forward. Custom providers can be reached on their base provider's passthrough route through `x-model-provider` once they have a policy
- **Codex with ChatGPT Sign-In** - `/chatgpt_passthrough` forwards `GET /backend-api/codex/models`, so Codex signed in with ChatGPT runs through Bifrost with the virtual key in `x-bf-vk`. The model list skips the virtual key's model allowlist because it runs no model, and each responses turn is still checked. Only a token ChatGPT issued is forwarded, and the served `service_tier` is recorded in passthrough logs
- **Vertex OpenAI-Format Endpoints** - A Vertex alias can point at a custom Vertex endpoint (vLLM or another container) that accepts OpenAI chat completions, through `vertex_endpoint` with `raw_predict` or `predict`, and non-chat operations are no longer refused on those aliases
- **Azure Blob Storage** - Log payload and skills-file storage on Azure Blob with default Azure identity or connection-string authentication, JSON/gzip and Parquet support, and config-file configuration. Structured environment and vault references can omit `value` (thanks [@CallumWayve](https://github.com/CallumWayve)!)
- **Log CSV Export** - The Logs page exports the filtered logs to CSV (thanks [@Shashank2985](https://github.com/Shashank2985)!)
- **Fallback Chain in Log Details** - Log details show a banner and timeline for the fallback chain a request went through
- **Hide the Setup Checklist** - A new `disable_onboarding` flag hides the setup checklist on stateless and provider-less deployments
- **Developer Role and Mid-Conversation System Messages** - Models whose datasheet row sets `supports_developer_role` to false get developer messages as `system`, and system messages after the opening run are folded in for models that reject them
- **Gemini 4 Thinking Level** - A thinking budget sent to Gemini 4 models becomes `thinkingLevel` (up to 1024 is `low`, up to 8192 is `medium`, anything larger is `high`), since these models refuse `thinkingBudget`
- **Gemini Long-Decode Continuation** - Gemini hops that end with `finishReason: CONTINUATION` carry their `continuationToken`, so clients can request the next hop
- **Fireworks disable_store** - Fireworks Responses requests honour `disable_store`
- **Databricks List Models** - `/v1/models?provider=databricks` lists the key's configured models and aliases instead of returning nothing
- **Model Creation Time** - The model catalog keeps the creation time each provider reports for a model
- **Realtime Metadata** - Plugins can carry opted-in HTTP metadata into native realtime turns and Live billing units
- **ClickHouse User Agent Mappings** - The ClickHouse log store gets the user agent mappings table the SQL stores already have
- **Bedrock Tool Strict Mode** - `strict` on a tool reaches Converse `toolSpec.strict` for Claude on Bedrock
- **Tracing Hooks** - `HoldTraceFlush` delays trace export until background writers such as post-delivery guardrails finish, and `SetSpanStartTime` lets a span opened after its work shows the work's real duration

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Startup No Longer Fails on a New Key's Unknown Grant** - A virtual key added in config.json whose `agent_grants` (or `relay_grants`) named an agent or relay that is not stored failed the whole governance sync, and Bifrost exited at startup. That grant is now skipped with a warning and the key is created, as an existing key's update already did. Agent grants in config.json belong on the agent (`agents[].virtual_key_ids`): agents load after virtual keys, so a key cannot grant an agent declared in the same file on its first start
- **Anthropic Sonnet 5.5 Passthrough** - Native Sonnet 5.5 requests forward the caller's reasoning and sampling settings on both the typed and raw paths (thanks [@valentinyanakiev](https://github.com/valentinyanakiev)!)
- **Anthropic message_delta** - Streaming `message_delta` frames keep their required `delta` object and report only the usage the upstream sent (thanks [@valentinyanakiev](https://github.com/valentinyanakiev)!)
- **DeepSeek Document Blocks** - Document content blocks are rejected before egress on DeepSeek's Anthropic endpoint, which documents them as unsupported but silently ignores them (thanks [@valentinyanakiev](https://github.com/valentinyanakiev)!)
- **Bridged Thinking Signatures** - Thinking blocks bridged from Chat Completions `reasoning_content` no longer get a synthetic signature (thanks [@rxchitrx](https://github.com/rxchitrx)!)
- **Anthropic Web Search on Chat Completions** - The streamed web search query stays server-side instead of leaking as an orphan `tool_calls` delta, and text-block citations map to `annotations[].url_citation` (thanks [@brianhadley2026](https://github.com/brianhadley2026)!)
- **Gemini Tool-Call IDs** - Gemini and Vertex receive the tool-call id they issued instead of a ~500-character id carrying the embedded thought signature, which the model copied as text (thanks [@Vivek1898](https://github.com/Vivek1898)!)
- **Bedrock Connection Errors** - A failed connection and a stream dropped after the `200` report a `502` from upstream instead of a `400`, so Anthropic clients such as Claude Code get a retryable `api_error` (thanks [@dinhxuanvu](https://github.com/dinhxuanvu)!)
- **Bedrock Streaming stop_reason** - `invoke-with-response-stream` ends a tool-call turn with `stop_reason: tool_use` instead of `end_turn` (thanks [@pcbeingused333](https://github.com/pcbeingused333)!)
- **Native web_search_call Replay** - OpenAI Responses requests keep the `id` and `status` of a native `web_search_call`, which OpenAI and Codex require on replay (thanks [@pcbeingused333](https://github.com/pcbeingused333)!)
- **extra_content-Only Stream Chunks** - OpenAI-compatible chat streams forward chunks whose delta carries only `extra_content` (thanks [@Javtor](https://github.com/Javtor)!)
- **Deterministic Datasheet Prices** - Datasheet sync stores one deterministic price when `bedrock` and `bedrock_mantle` rows share a model name (thanks [@aharshit123456](https://github.com/aharshit123456)!)
- **Sampling Params on Rows Without model_parameters** - Compat no longer strips every sampling param and substitutes the default `max_tokens` on datasheet rows without `model_parameters` (thanks [@ege-arhan](https://github.com/ege-arhan)!)
- **Logstore Without cgo** - `framework/logstore` builds with `CGO_ENABLED=0` again (thanks [@jeremym-tanium](https://github.com/jeremym-tanium)!)
- **Providers Page Load Error** - The providers page shows a load error instead of the "no providers configured" onboarding screen when the providers request fails (thanks [@hmdsefi](https://github.com/hmdsefi)!)
- **Anthropic Advisor Tool** - Advisor passes (`advisor_20260301`) are billed at the advisor model's rate instead of going unbilled, and governance checks the model a server tool names against the virtual key's model restrictions
- **Bedrock Tool Results and Prompt Caching** - A tool message with one text block renders like the same content sent as a string, so prompt caching holds across turns
- **Bedrock fallback-credit Beta** - The `fallback-credit-2026-06-01` beta header is no longer rewritten to a date Bedrock rejects
- **Bedrock GLM Tool Schemas** - The top-level tool-schema `pattern` that `zai.glm-5.3` rejects is dropped
- **Image Detail in Tool Outputs** - `input_image` blocks inside a tool output get the default `detail`, so strict OpenAI-compatible backends such as self-hosted vLLM accept them
- **Responses Reasoning Deltas** - Reasoning delta events that carry only a signature keep their required `delta` field
- **Mid-Conversation Tool Changes and Thinking Display** - `tool_addition` / `tool_removal` blocks are stripped on surfaces without the mid-conversation tool changes beta, and `thinking.display: "updates"` gets its beta header or is downgraded where unsupported
- **Responses WebSocket** - Responses WebSocket sessions accept `response.interrupt`, stay on the same provider key across turns, retry a refused encrypted reasoning replay, and a failed passthrough Responses stream ends with `response.failed`
- **Realtime Sessions** - Realtime turn lifecycles, logs and upstream errors are corrected, so an audio commit no longer blocks the next `response.create`, and the client socket closes when the upstream ends the session
- **OpenRouter Image Generation** - Images returned on `message.images` and streamed `delta.images` reach the response
- **Databricks** - The output ceiling is sent as `max_tokens`, `reasoning_effort` becomes `output_config.effort` on adaptive-only Claude, and key aliases stay unprefixed when a virtual key load balances them
- **List Models** - Each list-models page is bounded instead of the whole walk, so paginated providers are no longer cut off in aggregate listings. Aliases allowed only by `regex:` entries are listed, Vertex OAuth keys with deployments or allowlists list the Model Garden catalog, `unfiltered=true` returns the whole catalog, and integration routes such as `/anthropic/v1/models` include `max_input_tokens` from the model catalog
- **Image Pricing** - Image models called over chat and Responses are priced from their image generation row, token rates fall back to per-image pricing when the row has none, Gemini image usage counts `thoughtsTokenCount`, and GitHub Copilot datasheet rows match their provider
- **Routing** - Complexity classification is skipped when other rule conditions already decide the outcome, and embeddings fall back to single-text requests when a batch is refused
- **Latency and Spans** - Multi-turn MCP code-mode requests keep upstream time across turns, streaming spans carry token usage, chunk count and TTFC, plugin post-hook spans have real durations, background spans stay out of the overhead breakdown, and `bifrost_overhead_latency_microseconds` is emitted in Prometheus
- **Held Streams** - A stream held by a plugin commits its response as soon as the upstream produces output instead of waiting for the whole generation
- **MCP OAuth** - Protected resource metadata is used only when its resource matches the MCP server URL (RFC 9728), abandoned OAuth installs are swept, an expired token with no refresh token is marked `needs_reauth`, a public client can change its authorize and token URLs without a secret, and token and header credential evictions reach other processes
- **MCP Sessions and Errors** - A `404` is treated as a dead session only on protocol revisions that have sessions, an upstream `input_required` returns a clear error, and a rejected credential is refreshed in the background when an auth retry is skipped
- **Materialized View Refreshes** - Dashboard materialized view maintenance no longer keeps running on Postgres after the pod that started it is gone
- **Config Reload** - A config.json without a complexity `classifier` keeps the runtime classifier on reload, and SQLite client-config writes are serialized
- **npx Checksum** - The `npx` launcher verifies the downloaded gateway binary's checksum before running it
- **UI** - The date range picker uses the active timezone, the default cache key and vector store namespace can be cleared, MCP log links open a log outside the loaded page, and the MCP registry OAuth callback page is redesigned

## 🗄️ Database Migrations

- **add_client_config_skip_access_profile_user_virtual_key_lifecycle_columns** - Adds two client config columns that control access-profile user virtual key creation and deletion. Reversible: rolls back by dropping both columns.
- **add_passthrough_json_column** - Adds the per-provider passthrough route allowlist. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete every provider's passthrough allowlist.
- **add_warp_topic_discovery_min_requests_column** - Adds the Warp topic discovery threshold. Reversible: without the column discovery runs at the default.
- **add_azure_use_speech_endpoints_column** - Adds the Azure key `use_speech_endpoints` flag. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the column.
- **add_azure_use_voice_live_endpoints_column** - Adds the Azure key `use_voice_live_endpoints` flag. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the column.
- **add_sagemaker_key_columns** - Adds the SageMaker key config columns. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the columns.
- **widen_oauth2_client_id_columns** - Widens OAuth `client_id` columns beyond `varchar(255)` for CIMD URLs. Non-reversible: longer client IDs may already be stored.
- **add_oauth2_refresh_token_client_display_name_column** - Adds a client display name to OAuth refresh tokens. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the column.
- **add_mcp_max_protocol_version_columns** - Adds the global and per-server MCP protocol cap. Non-reversible: dropping the columns would delete every configured cap.
- **add_mcp_client_discovered_resources_prompts_columns** - Stores discovered MCP resources, resource templates and prompts. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the columns.
- **add_mcp_client_expose_lists_columns** - Adds `prompts_to_expose` and `resources_to_expose`. Non-reversible: dropping the allow-lists would expose every prompt and resource they restrict.
- **add_oauth_issuer_binding_columns** - Binds MCP OAuth credentials to their issuing authorization server. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the columns.
- **add_mcp_client_discovered_tool_details_column** - Stores discovered MCP tool titles, icons and output schemas. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the column.
- **add_relays_tables** - Creates the relay, route and virtual key grant tables. Non-reversible: dropping them would delete relay endpoints, their credentials and virtual key grants.
- **add_video_token_pricing_column** - Adds `output_cost_per_video_token`. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete custom per-token video prices and bill token-metered video at $0.
- **add_voice_live_pricing_columns** - Adds Azure Voice Live pricing columns. Non-reversible: dropping them would delete every Voice Live rate an operator set.
- **logs_add_warp_topic_tables** - Creates the Warp topic, assignment and unmatched tables in the log store. Non-reversible once populated: topics outlive the requests they were built from and cannot be rebuilt from the logs.
- **logs_add_warp_vector_deletes_table** - Creates the pending vector deletes table. Non-reversible while it holds rows: they list deleted logs whose vectors are still in the vector store.
- **mcp_tool_logs_add_method_column** - Adds `method` to MCP tool logs for prompt and resource reads. Reversible: rolls back by dropping the column.
- **add_relay_logs_table** - Creates the relay logs table (also created in ClickHouse). Non-reversible: it holds recorded call history and charges.

All new migrations only add columns or tables, so older binaries ignore them during a rolling upgrade.

## 🐙 Closed GitHub Issues

- [#5649](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/5649) - [Bug]: defaultImageDetail fix (#5352) doesn't cover images inside function_call_output (tool results), Responses API to self-host vLLM still fails
- [#7189](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/7189) - [Bug]: Realtime audio commit blocks subsequent response.create with active-response error
- [#7319](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/7319) - [Bug]: /anthropic/v1/models omits max_input_tokens - integration list-models route never enriches from the model catalog
- [#7655](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/7655) - [Bug]: Anthropic web search on /v1/chat/completions leaks the search query as an orphan tool_calls delta and drops citations
- [#8152](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8152) - [Feature]: Allow setup checklist to be dismissed persistently on stateless / provider-less deployments
- [#8268](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8268) - [Bug]: Providers page shows the "no providers configured" onboarding screen when the providers request fails
- [#8382](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8382) - [Bug]: Bifrost 2.2.6 strips web_search_call.status from Responses history, breaking Codex replay
- [#8489](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8489) - [Bug]: Datasheet sync stores a random price when bedrock and bedrock_mantle rows share a model name
- [#8546](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8546) - [Bug]: Gemini/Vertex receives the full `_ts_`-embedded call id as `functionCall.id`, so the model sees (and copies) ~500-char ids
- [#8547](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8547) - [Bug]: Abandoned shared OAuth MCP installs leave oauth_configs rows pending forever
- [#8549](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8549) - [Bug]: thinking blocks bridged from Chat Completions reasoning_content get a synthetic brid_ signature
- [#8550](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8550) - [Bug]: Bedrock invoke-with-response-stream reports `stop_reason: "end_turn"` for tool-use turns
- [#8594](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8594) - [Feature]: Export filtered logs to CSV from the Logs page
- [#8759](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8759) - [Bug]: GET /v1/models omits models from a paginated provider in aggregate listings
- [#8765](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8765) - [Bug]: Bedrock datasheet rows without model_parameters make compat drop all sampling params and substitute the model default max_tokens
- [#8801](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8801) - [Bug]: Bedrock: a tool message with one text block renders as text, but the same content as a string renders as json, which breaks prompt caching across turns
- [#8824](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8824) - [Bug]: framework/logstore no longer builds with CGO_ENABLED=0
- [#8934](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8934) - [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible chat streams drop chunks whose delta carries only extra_content
- [#8963](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8963) - [Bug]: Bedrock stream dropped mid-response reaches Anthropic clients as invalid_request_error
- [#8970](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost/issues/8970) - [Bug]: Bedrock returns HTTP 400 when it can't connect to the provider

### Installation

#### Docker
```bash
docker run -p 8080:8080 maximhq/bifrost:v2.4.0
```

#### Binary Download
```bash
npx @maximhq/bifrost --transport-version v2.4.0
```

### Docker Images
- **`maximhq/bifrost:v2.4.0`** - This specific version
- **`maximhq/bifrost:latest`** - Latest version (updated with this release)

name: Framework v1.11.1
body:
## Framework Release v1.11.1

- feat: relay config store, virtual key relay grants, relay logs (SQL and ClickHouse) and async job settlement
- feat: Warp topics: clustering tables, topic assignment at index time, discovery, labelling, themes, windowed counts with trends, log filters by topic, pending vector deletes, pruning, config.json support and upkeep as a job
- feat: added Azure Blob object storage for logs and skills with connection-string or default Azure identity authentication, JSON/gzip and Parquet support (thanks [@CallumWayve](https://github.com/CallumWayve)!)
- feat: MCP config store persists max protocol versions, discovered resources, prompts and tool details, prompt and resource allow-lists, OAuth issuer bindings and CIMD client ids
- feat: per-provider passthrough allowlist, SageMaker and Azure speech / Voice Live key columns, and Voice Live and per-token video pricing columns
- feat: ClickHouse log store gets user agent mappings, and per-entity rollups read usage in one pass
- feat: model catalog keeps each model's provider-reported creation time
- feat: MiniMax and BytePlus video jobs are settled and priced by the video job sweeper, with Seedance priced by output tokens
- fix: MCP OAuth discovery uses protected resource metadata only when its resource matches the MCP server URL (RFC 9728)
- fix: logstore builds without cgo again (thanks [@jeremym-tanium](https://github.com/jeremym-tanium)!)
- fix: Gemini image models called without the IMAGE response modality (e.g. from Antigravity on /genai) are priced from their image_generation row instead of logging $0, output image tokens bill at the image-token rate, and unattributed output tokens on image calls bill at the text rate
- fix: image pricing falls back to per-image or per-pixel rates when reported tokens have no rate
- fix: datasheet sync stores one deterministic price when rows fold onto one key (thanks [@aharshit123456](https://github.com/aharshit123456)!)
- fix: datasheet rows without model_parameters no longer make compat strip sampling params (thanks [@ege-arhan](https://github.com/ege-arhan)!)
- fix: GitHub Copilot datasheet rows match the github_copilot provider
- fix: Anthropic advisor iterations are priced at the advisor model's rate
- fix: abandoned oauth_configs rows from never-completed MCP OAuth installs are swept, an expired credential with no refresh token is marked needs_reauth, and token and header credential cache evictions reach other processes
- fix: materialized view maintenance is bounded server-side and cancelled on shutdown
- fix: config.json without a classifier keeps the runtime classifier on reload, SQLite client-config writes are serialized, and relay credentials are hashed by reference
- fix: passthrough logs record the served service tier
- chore: upgraded core to v1.14.0

### Installation

```bash
go get github.com/maximhq/bifrost/framework@v1.11.1
```

name: Core v1.14.1
body:
## Core Release v1.14.1

- feat: relays to non-LLM APIs with a single credential, per-route pricing and usage mapping, streaming, header matchers on any header name, and relay plugin hooks for access, budgets and logging
- feat: AWS SageMaker provider for real-time endpoints (OpenAI-compatible chat) plus InvokeEndpoint and InvokeEndpointWithResponseStream passthrough
- feat: MiniMax provider for chat, Responses, image generation, video generation, speech and transcription
- feat: BytePlus ModelArk provider for Seed chat, native Responses, multimodal embeddings, Seedream image generation, editing and streaming, and Seedance video generation with task options
- feat: Azure AI Speech text-to-speech and transcription (use_speech_endpoints), Voice Live realtime sessions (use_voice_live_endpoints) and GPT Live, with voices in list models, Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key support, the served model and billing header, and Whisper usage derived from audio duration
- feat: Bedrock Nova Sonic realtime through the OpenAI Realtime translator and a RealtimeConnector for providers that do not speak WebSocket
- feat: mcp-go v1.3.0 with a global and per-server max protocol version, upstream prompts, resources and resource templates, tool output schemas, titles, icons and multimodal results, tools/list_changed notifications, CIMD client registration, and HTTP connection reuse for per-call clients
- feat: GitHub Copilot keys take a PAT or OAuth token, Claude models route to /v1/messages, and OpenAI models get native Responses and embeddings
  <Warning>
  The GitHub App installation mode and GithubCopilotKeyConfig are removed. A GitHub Copilot key needs a token in value.
  </Warning>
- feat: native decisions on vLLM, SGLang, Databricks System One and Azure gpt-6-luna; OpenAI decisions accept conversation items, JSON parts and prompt caching
- feat: per-provider passthrough route allowlist, reachable for custom providers through x-model-provider
- feat: Vertex aliases route to custom OpenAI-format Vertex endpoints through vertex_endpoint
- feat: Gemini 4 receives a thinking budget as thinkingLevel (up to 1024 low, up to 8192 medium, higher high)
- feat: Gemini long-decode continuation tokens are passed through
- feat: Fireworks Responses requests honour disable_store
- feat: Databricks lists the key's models and aliases in /v1/models
- feat: developer messages are sent as system to models whose datasheet row sets supports_developer_role to false, and mid-conversation system messages are folded for models that reject them (thanks [@salarali](https://github.com/salarali)!)
- feat: opted-in metadata propagates to realtime and Live units
- feat: Tracer.HoldTraceFlush and Span.SetStartTime

name: Bifrost HTTP v2.3.2
body:
## Bifrost HTTP Transport Release v2.3.2

## 🔒 Security

- **Go 1.27.3** - Security release for [CVE-2026-111943](https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/66pojueaQek) in `crypto/x509`: certificate chains through a small set of intermediates from a specific Certificate Authority are no longer accepted by `Verify`, which covers every TLS connection Bifrost makes to providers, MCP servers and other upstreams. Bifrost now builds with Go 1.27.3, and the Docker images (`Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.local`, `Dockerfile.redhat`) move to `golang:1.27.3-alpine3.24`. Custom Go plugins must be rebuilt with Go 1.27.3 to load.

## 🔧 Maintenance

- **Dependency Upgrades** - Bumped core to v1.13.1 and framework to v1.10.1 across all modules

## 🗄️ Database Migrations

- No new database migrations in this release.

### Installation

#### Docker
```bash
docker run -p 8080:8080 maximhq/bifrost:v2.3.2
```

#### Binary Download
```bash
npx @maximhq/bifrost --transport-version v2.3.2
```

### Docker Images
- **`maximhq/bifrost:v2.3.2`** - This specific version
- **`maximhq/bifrost:latest`** - Latest version (updated with this release)

name: Bifrost HTTP v2.3.1
body:
## Bifrost HTTP Transport Release v2.3.1

## ✨ Features

- **OpenAPI MCP Servers** - New `openapi` MCP connection type. Bifrost turns an OpenAPI or Swagger document (inline `spec`, config.json-only `spec_file`, or `spec_url`, capped at 5 MiB) into an in-process MCP server where each operation is a tool that calls the upstream API, with `security_credentials` per security scheme, an optional `base_url`, `include_deprecated` and `max_response_bytes`. Configure it in config.json, the MCP management API, or the new OpenAPI option in the New MCP Server sheet, which can also replace the document later. Go SDK users opt in with `MCPConfig.InProcessServerFactory` (#8307, #8308, #8309, #8310, #8311, #8312, #8313, #8314, #8315, #8558)
- **Gateway Tool Search** - Requests that defer tools with `defer_loading` on a model with no tool search of its own (Gemini, older GPT, Bedrock non-Claude) no longer get every tool loaded up front or a rejection. The deferred tools sit behind a `bifrost_tool_search` function that Bifrost resolves in the gateway (`select:` or BM25, at most 3 model calls per request), on both non-streaming and streaming Responses requests (#8504, #8505)
- **Passthrough Logs as Conversations** - With content logging on, passthrough calls (`/openai_passthrough`, `/anthropic_passthrough`, `/genai_passthrough`, ...) are parsed into the same fields as typed requests: chat, Responses, Anthropic messages, Gemini, embeddings, speech, transcription and images. Streamed responses are rebuilt from the recorded SSE, and multipart uploads are logged as a form summary. Rows are stored under their inferred request type with an `is_passthrough` flag, count in per-type filters, render as a conversation in the log sheet, and keep the raw bodies alongside (#8516, #8517, #8518, #8519, #8520, #8521, #8522, #8523, #8524, #8525)
- **Extra Fields as Response Headers** - New `client.extra_fields_placement` setting: `body` (default, unchanged behaviour) or `headers`. With `headers`, inference responses drop the `extra_fields` object from the body and send it as `x-bifrost-*` response headers on native and integration routes, unary and streaming. Set it in Client Settings, the config API or config.json (#8476, #8477, #8478)
- **Virtual Key Metadata** - Virtual keys carry string key/value `metadata` (for example `cost_center`, `owner`; keys use letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, values up to 512 characters, up to 50 entries) set from config.json, Helm (`bifrost.governance.virtualKeys[].metadata`), the API (omit to keep, `{}` to clear) or the virtual key sheet. The list API filters by `metadata_<key>=<value>` and `search` matches metadata. Each log carries a snapshot of its key's metadata, so logs and spend filter by it, and the key's values override `x-bf-lh-*`, logging headers and `x-bf-dim-*` dimensions so callers cannot spoof attribution (#7934, #7935, #7936, #7937, #8680) (thanks [@jimseiwert](https://github.com/jimseiwert)!)
- **News Feeds** - The notification tray has a News tab with product and provider announcements from RSS and Atom feeds (Bifrost, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and Cursor built in). Admins toggle built-in feeds and add custom ones with their own logo; the gateway fetches, caches and merges them server-side through `/api/rss/feeds` and `/api/rss/items` (#8537, #8538, #8539, #8540)
- **Code Mode Scripting** - The Starlark sandbox adds the `json` and `math` modules. A failed nested tool call reaches the script as an error value (`hasattr(r, "error")`, `r.error`) instead of a plain string, the `executeToolCode` reply carries only what the script prints and returns, runtime errors include a Python-style traceback, and error hints match the messages the interpreter actually emits (#8605, #8606, #8607, #8692, #8693)
- **Native Decisions on Azure and Databricks** - `/v1/decisions` reaches Microsoft's `Microsoft-Decision-1` on Azure (Foundry `/providers/microsoft/v1/systemone`, with API key, Entra ID or managed identity auth) and Databricks `ai_decide`. Typesafe accepts images by reference and answers `box` questions (#8485, #8498, #8571)
- **Vertex Session Routing** - Vertex keys accept `use_session_routing: true`, which sends the request's prompt cache key as `sessionId` on Gemini `generateContent` calls so requests sharing a prefix reach the same replica's implicit cache. Off by default, since Google enables it per project (#8650)
- **Secret References in Extra Headers** - `network_config.extra_headers` values accept `env.` and `vault.` references. Values are masked in API responses and restored on save, and the network form and the Databricks and Cloudflare migration planners treat masked values as unreadable (#8618, #8619, #8620)
- **Prompt Caching on Tool Calls** - `cache_control` on an assistant message's `tool_calls` entry on `/v1/chat/completions` now reaches the Anthropic and Bedrock `tool_use` block instead of being dropped (#8494, #8495)
- **Mistral Thinking Blocks** - Mistral streams that carry `thinking` blocks in `delta.content` arrays map them to reasoning instead of failing, and assistant reasoning is dropped before a request is sent, so replayed multi-turn conversations no longer hit Mistral's 422 `extra_forbidden` (#8567, #8612)
- **Observability Attributes** - Spans and Prometheus metrics carry the stored prompt a request ran (`bifrost.prompt.id`, `name`, `version`), MCP spans carry the client name and `bifrost.mcp.tool.is_error` when a tool reports failure, and the inbound W3C `tracestate` is captured for connectors. A2A operations export bodies, stream updates and the `a2a.client.operation.duration` metric to OTel, Maxim and telemetry, and gRPC ingress keeps caller request and trace IDs (#8575, #8681, #8682, #8683)
- **Calendar Date Presets** - The date filter adds Today, This week and This month. The server resolves them in the caller's time zone (#8592)
- **MCP OAuth Redirect URI Wildcard** - `oauth2_server_config.allowed_redirect_uris` syncs from config.json and accepts a bare `"*"` to approve any remote callback (shape checks still apply; partial patterns return 400). A startup warning and a dashboard alert flag the wildcard, and the MCP settings page has an Allowed redirect URIs input (#8480)
- **Antigravity Client Detection** - Requests from Antigravity CLI and Antigravity Desktop are logged as their own apps instead of Other or Gemini CLI, including behind the edge proxy (#8543, #8658)

## 🐞 Fixed

- **Go Module Path** - The transports module is now published as `github.com/maximhq/bifrost/transports/v2`, so `go get` resolves the `v2.x` tags (#8450)
  <Note>
  Go code that imports `github.com/maximhq/bifrost/transports/bifrost-http/...` must switch to `github.com/maximhq/bifrost/transports/v2/bifrost-http/...`.
  </Note>
- **Explicit Public URLs for Agent Gateway and Skills** - Bifrost no longer builds agent-card endpoints or skills marketplace clone URLs from the incoming `Host` header, which a caller controls. These URLs come only from the configured public URL; an existing `mcp_external_client_url` is copied to the new `skills_external_client_url` on upgrade when it is a public URL. The MCP settings page also requires an Issuer URL in OAuth and Both modes (#8484, #8526)
  <Warning>
  If your Agent Gateway or skills marketplace relied on the request host, set the public URL explicitly before upgrading, or clients receive no usable agent-card endpoint.
  </Warning>
- **Agent Gateway Destination Permissions** - Card discovery, OAuth and JSON-RPC, REST and gRPC runtime connections (including through a proxy) only reach approved destinations and only forward credentials to permitted origins, per agent `credential_origins` and `require_public_target`. The unused `tenant` and `extension_uris` registration options are removed (#8552)
- **A2A Idle Goroutine Leak** - The A2A push relay no longer leaks one goroutine every 3 seconds (about 1,200 per hour on v2.3.0, until OOM), and ClickHouse no longer issues a heavyweight `agent_logs` mutation every minute when no rows match (#8596)
- **Calendar-Aligned Reset Windows** - Calendar-aligned budgets and rate limits honour the duration multiplier, so a `7d` budget no longer resets daily and a `2w` limit no longer resets weekly (#8596)
- **Agent OAuth Cache and ClickHouse Contention** - The Agent Gateway OAuth token and fingerprint caches are bounded at 5,000 entries (about 12 MB) with expired entries evicted first, and a failed token fetch drops its stale entry. ClickHouse agent-log correlation no longer loads large payload columns or rewrites complete rows, so large A2A responses no longer back up the logging queue (#8608, #8617, #8657)
- **Request Body Memory Retention** - Pooled keep-alive connections no longer keep their largest-ever request-body buffer, which made per-pod memory ratchet up with large LLM payloads. Buffers above `server.body_buffer_pool_limit_bytes` (default 4 MiB) are released after each request; larger bodies are still accepted up to `max_request_body_size_mb`. Set a negative value to restore the previous behaviour. Async jobs (`x-bf-async`) that forward the raw body now copy it instead of reading a buffer the next request can overwrite (#8602)
- **Oversized Request Bodies** - A body above `client_config.max_request_body_size_mb` returns `413` with `request_too_large` and the configured limit, and logs a warning, instead of a generic `400 Error when parsing request` (#8700)
- **Rolling Upgrade Migrations** - Postgres migrations wait for a live `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` from a killed pod instead of dropping it, logstore upgrade migrations no longer stall behind long queries on old replicas, and the Helm chart adds a configurable `startupProbe` (#8479, #8572)
- **OpenAI-Compatible xhigh Reasoning Effort** - `reasoning_effort: "xhigh"` is forwarded to vLLM, Ollama, SGL and custom OpenAI-compatible providers instead of being rewritten to `high` (#6244) (thanks [@pranavthakur0-0](https://github.com/pranavthakur0-0)!)
- **Tool Search Round-Trips** - Deferred tools on OpenAI gpt-5.4+ (and Azure and Bedrock gpt) get the `tool_search` OpenAI requires instead of a 400. OpenAI `tool_search_call` and `tool_search_output` items render for `/anthropic` clients. Claude's server tool search `server_tool_use` and `tool_search_tool_result` blocks replay unchanged, and `tool_reference` blocks in a client `tool_result` survive on the Anthropic and Vertex routes (#7813, #8502, #8503, #8555) (thanks [@CMWR421](https://github.com/CMWR421)!)
- **Client web_search and web_fetch Tools** - On the Anthropic endpoint, a client `tool_use` named `web_search` or `web_fetch` stays a function call instead of becoming a server tool call, so its `tool_result` is no longer orphaned and Bedrock stops rejecting the replay (#8370) (thanks [@17jmumford](https://github.com/17jmumford)!)
- **Bedrock Prompt Caching** - Anthropic automatic caching (top-level `cache_control`) now creates a Bedrock cache point after the last cacheable block instead of being dropped, and `cache_control` on a tool message emits one standalone `cachePoint` after the `toolResult` (#8573, #8595)
- **OpenRouter Claude Cache Markers** - `cache_control` markers to Claude models on OpenRouter are clamped to four, so Claude no longer rejects the request (#8512)
- **Parallel Tool Calls on Claude** - `parallel_tool_calls: false` and `tool_choice.disable_parallel_tool_use` reach Claude on every path (Anthropic Responses, Bedrock, Vertex), not only `/v1/chat/completions` to Anthropic direct (#8471)
- **Responses Instructions with System Messages** - Top-level `instructions` are no longer dropped when the input also has a system or developer message; they lead the system prompt as OpenAI does (#8515)
- **Chat Tool Results on Responses Models** - Tool messages with array content use Responses input block types, and an empty tool result keeps `output: ""`, so OpenAI and Azure no longer reject the converted request (#8514, #8621)
- **Responses Streaming Wire Format** - Lifecycle events no longer send `output: null` and no longer carry an invalid item object, which crashed or aborted strict clients (#8563)
- **Responses Input Items** - `configuration_update` items reach OpenAI with their reasoning effort (and are dropped on routes that cannot accept them), and replayed assistant messages with an `id` keep their `status` (#8599, #8634)
- **Converted Chat Stream Identity** - Chat streams served through the Responses conversion carry the upstream `id`, `model` and `created` on every chunk, so clients no longer see empty text (#8699)
- **Gemini Prompt Blocks** - A prompt Gemini or Vertex refuses outright (`promptFeedback.blockReason`) returns an error instead of a completed response with empty output (#8564)
- **Reasoning Token Usage** - Gemini and Vertex batch results include thinking tokens in `completion_tokens` and report `reasoning_tokens`, and SGLang's top-level `usage.reasoning_tokens` maps to `completion_tokens_details` (#8600, #8687) (thanks [@Shashank2985](https://github.com/Shashank2985)!)
- **Bedrock Converse Round-Trip** - Converse responses keep `stopReason` and `additionalModelResponseFields` verbatim (#8704)
- **Prompt Cache Mode on Bedrock Converse** - `prompt_cache_options` in `additionalModelRequestFields` on `/bedrock` Converse and ConverseStream now reaches OpenAI, Azure and Bedrock Mantle gpt-5.6 models. Send `{"mode": "explicit"}` with a `cachePoint` after the system prompt to cache only the system prompt, or without a `cachePoint` to turn caching off (#8554)
- **Azure Deployments Route** - Unknown chat fields are forwarded on the `/openai/deployments/...` route instead of being dropped (#8703)
- **Decisions** - Custom OpenAI-base providers are gated on `/v1/decisions` by their allowed requests alone, so models outside OpenAI's own list are no longer rejected with `unsupported_operation`, and answer objects a model JSON-encodes as strings are recovered (#8617, #8626, #8705)
- **Zero-Key Custom Providers in Routing** - A custom provider with no keys no longer claims every model during provider inference, and `no_key_supports_model` no longer stops the fallback chain (#8706)
- **Keyless Provider Discovery** - A custom provider switched from keyed to keyless runs model discovery despite leftover disabled keys, and those keys can be deleted (#8530)
- **Provider Key enabled in config.json** - `enabled` on a provider key in config.json or Helm now persists across restarts, without re-syncing keys that UI edits had turned back on (#8610, #8647)
- **MCP Endpoint Slugs** - A config.json MCP client without an `endpoint_slug` keeps its derived slug across re-syncs, so `/mcp/<slug>` no longer returns 403 after a reboot (#8535)
- **MCP Library Installed Badge** - "Installed" is computed server-side over every MCP client, not only the first 100 matched by URL or name (#8581)
- **Code Mode Tool Results** - Tools restored from the config store keep their parameters in Starlark stubs, and nested results arrive as structured values: multiple JSON blocks, `structuredContent` and JSON-in-a-string are decoded (#8603, #8604)
- **OAuth Refresh Failures** - Token endpoint rejections are classified by OAuth error code, so Slack and Atlassian refresh failures prompt re-auth (#8559)
- **Throughput Metric** - Dashboard tokens/sec counts only inference requests, so `list_models` and similar calls no longer skew it (#8579)
- **Passthrough Logs** - Passthrough log keys no longer show "(deleted)", and passthrough streams with no upstream `Content-Type` are no longer labelled `text/plain` (#8601, #8638, #8689)
- **SQLite Log Writes** - SQLite `SQLITE_BUSY` and `SQLITE_LOCKED` are treated as transient, and a failed batch is retried whole instead of row by row (#8707)
- **Model Catalog Prices** - Per-1M token prices show up to 4 decimals, so `$0.075` no longer displays as `$0.08` (#8326) (thanks [@Shashank2985](https://github.com/Shashank2985)!)

## 🗄️ Database Migrations

- **add_mcp_client_openapi_spec_column** - Adds `openapi_spec` to `config_mcp_clients`. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete the only stored copy of every OpenAPI client's document. Additive; older binaries ignore it.
- **add_mcp_client_openapi_config_json_column** - Adds `openapi_config_json` to `config_mcp_clients`. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete every OpenAPI client's base URL and stored credentials. Additive.
- **add_client_config_extra_fields_placement_column** - Adds `extra_fields_placement` (`NOT NULL DEFAULT 'body'`) to `config_client`. Reversible: rollback drops the column.
- **add_skills_external_client_url_column** - Adds `skills_external_client_url` to `config_client`. Non-reversible: dropping it would discard marketplace configuration. Additive.
- **backfill_skills_external_client_url** - Copies `mcp_external_client_url` into `skills_external_client_url` where it is empty and the value is a public URL. Non-reversible: migrated marketplace configuration is preserved.
- **add_virtual_key_metadata_column** - Adds the nullable `metadata` column to `governance_virtual_keys`. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete every key's metadata. Additive.
- **add_a2a_private_allowlist_column** - Adds `a2a_private_allowlist_json` to `config_client`. Reversible: rollback drops the column.
- **add_agent_destination_policy_columns** - Adds `credential_origins` and `require_public_target` to `config_agent_registrations`. Non-reversible: removing them would discard security policy. Additive.
- **drop_agent_registration_options** - Drops `tenant` and `extension_uris` from `config_agent_registrations`. Non-reversible: the removed values cannot be recovered.
  <Warning>
  This migration drops columns. An older binary running alongside it during a rolling upgrade loses access to those values, and rolling back does not restore them.
  </Warning>
- **add_vertex_use_session_routing_column** - Adds `vertex_use_session_routing` to the provider keys table. Reversible: rollback drops the column.
- **add_rss_feeds_table** - Creates `rss_feeds` and seeds the built-in feeds. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete custom feeds, their logos and every built-in enabled choice. Additive.
- **add_rss_feeds_icon_url_column** - Adds `icon_url` to `rss_feeds` tables created before it existed. Non-reversible: dropping it would delete every custom feed logo. Additive.
- **logs_add_matview_refresh_state_table** - Creates `matview_refresh_state` to record when each materialized view last refreshed across the cluster. Reversible: rollback drops the table.
- **logs_add_is_passthrough_column** - Adds `is_passthrough` to `logs`. Rollback is a no-op and leaves the column in place. Additive.

body:
## Core Release v1.13.0

- feat: openapi MCP connection type, backed by an in-process server built through the new MCPConfig.InProcessServerFactory hook (#8307)
- feat: cache_control on chat assistant tool_calls reaches the Anthropic and Bedrock tool_use block (#8494)
- feat: native decisions on Azure (Microsoft-Decision-1) and Databricks (ai_decide), and Typesafe image assets by reference plus box questions (#8485, #8498, #8571)
- feat: Vertex keys accept use_session_routing to send the prompt cache key as sessionId (#8650)
- feat: NetworkConfig.ExtraHeaders values accept env. and vault. references and are fully redacted in API responses (#8618, #8619)
- feat: Mistral streamed thinking blocks map to reasoning, and assistant reasoning is dropped before sending to avoid 422 extra_forbidden (#8567)
- feat: code mode adds the json and math Starlark modules, returns failed tool calls as error values, trims replies to what the script prints and returns, and adds tracebacks and accurate error hints (#8605, #8606, #8607, #8692, #8693)
- feat: spans carry the stored prompt (bifrost.prompt.id/name/version), MCP client name and bifrost.mcp.tool.is_error, and the inbound W3C tracestate; A2A operations export complete observability data (#8575, #8681, #8682, #8683)
- feat: Antigravity CLI and Antigravity Desktop user agent detection (#8543)
- fix: Anthropic tool_reference blocks in a client tool_result survive for custom tool search (thanks [@CMWR421](https://github.com/CMWR421)!) (#7813)
- fix: Claude server tool search blocks replay unchanged (#8555)
- fix: Bedrock creates a cache point for Anthropic automatic caching and emits a standalone cachePoint after toolResult (#8573, #8595)
- fix: Bedrock Converse prompt_cache_options in additionalModelRequestFields reaches Params.PromptCacheOptions, so gpt-5.6 targets run in the caller's cache mode (#8554)
- fix: OpenRouter clamps cache_control markers to four for Claude models (#8512)
- fix: parallel_tool_calls false reaches Claude on every path (#8471)
- fix: Responses instructions are merged ahead of system and developer messages instead of dropped (#8515)
- fix: chat tool results convert to Responses input block types and keep an empty output (#8514, #8621)
- fix: Responses lifecycle events no longer send output null or an invalid item object (#8563)
- fix: configuration_update items are forwarded with their reasoning effort, and assistant messages with an id keep their status (#8599, #8634)
- fix: converted chat streams keep id, model and created on every chunk (#8699)
- fix: Gemini promptFeedback.blockReason returns an error instead of an empty completed response (#8564)
- fix: SGLang top-level usage.reasoning_tokens maps to completion_tokens_details (#8600)
- fix: Bedrock Converse responses keep stopReason and additionalModelResponseFields verbatim (#8704)
- fix: Azure deployments route forwards unknown chat fields (#8703)
- fix: custom OpenAI-base providers are gated on decisions by allowed requests alone, and stringified decision answer objects are recovered (#8617, #8626, #8705)
- fix: no_key_supports_model no longer stops the inferred fallback chain (#8706)
- fix: Agent Gateway OAuth caches bounded at 5,000 entries, A2A relay goroutine leak, destination permissions and credential boundaries (#8552, #8596, #8608, #8657)
- fix: code mode stubs render restored tool schemas, and nested tool results arrive as structured values (#8603, #8604)
- chore: Go 1.27.2 (#8570)
- [fix]: Gemini and Vertex batch results include thinking tokens (thoughtsTokenCount) in completion_tokens and report reasoning_tokens (#8684) [@Shashank2985](https://github.com/Shashank2985)
- [fix]: Anthropic-compatible requests keep a client tool_use named web_search or web_fetch as a function call. Only server_tool_use blocks become web_search_call / web_fetch_call, so the tool_result is no longer orphaned and Bedrock stops rejecting the replay with "toolResult blocks ... exceeds the number of toolUse blocks" [@jacob-pattern](https://github.com/jacob-pattern)
- fix: OpenAI tool_search_call / tool_search_output items reach /anthropic clients - a client-executed search becomes a tool_use for the client's own search function, a hosted search becomes server_tool_use plus tool_search_tool_result
- fix: deferred tools on OpenAI gpt-5.4+ (and Azure / Bedrock gpt) get the tool_search OpenAI requires instead of a 400 - a client search function (Claude Code's ToolSearch) becomes a client-executed tool_search with its history replayed as tool_search_call / tool_search_output, otherwise the hosted tool_search is added (#8361)
- feat: gateway-run tool search for deferred tools on models with no tool search of their own (Gemini, older GPT, Bedrock non-Claude, ...) - the deferred tools are held back behind a bifrost_tool_search function that Bifrost resolves in the gateway (select: or BM25), at most 3 model calls per request (non-streaming)
- feat: the gateway-run tool search also serves streaming Responses requests, splicing the search turns into one client stream
- fix: preserve xhigh reasoning effort for OpenAI-compatible destinations (vLLM, Ollama, SGL, and custom providers) instead of rewriting it to high using OpenAI model-name rules [@pranavthakur0-0](https://github.com/pranavthakur0-0) (#6193)

### Installation

```bash
go get github.com/maximhq/bifrost/core@v1.13.0
```
